title: Canonical Ext-to-section homology identification with representatives
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F an abelian sheaf and I an injective resolution of F. Write A = abelianCechSections I [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction]. For every q there is an additive isomorphism e from Ext-based H^q(X,F) to H^q(A) such that for every class t there are a cocycle a from the constant integral sheaf to I^q and a cycle z of A in degree q: extMk(a)=t, the constant-sheaf adjunction evaluated at 1 sends a to iCycles(z), and e(t)=homologyπ(z).

source.place: Resolution computation implicit in Lemma 20.11.2; Mathlib CategoryTheory.Abelian.Injective.Ext, extAddEquivCohomologyClass and extMk_surjective

proof.text: Use the constant-sheaf adjunction homAddEquiv and uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv to identify Hom from the constant integral sheaf with terminal-open sections, additively and naturally. Compose with Cochain.fromSingleEquiv to obtain a chain isomorphism from the Hom complex of the single integral sheaf to sections of the integer-indexed resolution. Compose with mapExtendIso to identify its target with the extension by zero of abelianCechSections I. Compose extAddEquivCohomologyClass with leftHomologyData.homologyIso.symm, the induced homology isomorphism, and extendHomologyIso to obtain e.

For t, extMk_surjective supplies a and ha. Form the fromSingleMk cocycle x used by extMk. Apply leftHomologyData.cyclesIso.inv, cyclesMap of the constructed chain isomorphism, and extendCyclesIso.hom to obtain z. The cyclesIso inclusion equation, cyclesMap_i and extendCyclesIso_hom_iCycles identify its section with the adjunction evaluated at 1; differential naturality and cancellation of the degreewise equality transports give the formula. The extEquivCohomologyClass_extMk equation, pi_comp_homologyIso_inv, homologyPi_naturality and homologyPi_extendHomologyIso_hom identify e(t) with homologyPi(z). All constructions hold for q=0 and for zero sections without extra hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Resolution computation implicit in Lemma 20.11.2; Mathlib CategoryTheory.Abelian.Injective.Ext, extAddEquivCohomologyClass and extMk_surjective; B2 completes the explicit Hom-complex chain isomorphism, extension-by-zero transport, and representative equations in Lean

lean.statement:
theorem abelianCechExtSectionIso_exists
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ (e : (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q).obj F ≅
        (abelianCechSections I).homology q),
    ∀ (t : (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q).obj F),
      ∃ (a : (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)) ⟶ I.cocomplex.X q)
        (ha : a ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
        (z : (abelianCechSections I).cycles q),
        I.extMk a (q + 1) rfl ha = t ∧
        ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          isTerminalTop).homEquiv _ _ a) (ULift.up 1) =
            (abelianCechSections I).iCycles q z ∧
        e.hom t = (abelianCechSections I).homologyπ q z
